concerns.text: T040, T041, T042, T043, and T044 are marked as [P] (parallel-safe) in Phase 2, but they have explicit sequential dependencies on T018 (e.g., 'Requires T018 completion', 'Requires T018 and T040 completion'). Tagging them as [P] implies they can run concurrently with T018 or each, which violates the data-flow dependency where T018 defines the asymptotic regime required for the theoretical updates in T040-T044.

T011 (generate_partitions.py) lists dependencies on T018, T040, T041, and T044. However, T011 is the primary data producer for US2 and US3. If T018-T044 are delayed or fail, T011 cannot proceed. The current ordering places T011 in Phase 3 (US1) while its prerequisites (T018-T044) are in Phase 2 (Foundational). This is a valid dependency, but the [P] tag on T011 is misleading if it depends on the completion of the entire T018-T044 chain, which is not parallelizable.

T017d_new (HAC Correction) and T017e_new (Merge Results) are marked as [P] in the text description of Phase 4, but T017e_new explicitly depends on T017d_new ('Requires T017c and T017d_new completion'). Furthermore, T017d_new depends on T017a. These tasks form a strict serial chain (T017a -> T017d_new -> T017e_new) and cannot be parallelized. The [P] tag is incorrect and creates a false expectation of parallel execution.

T039 (Run Full Pipeline) is marked [P] but depends on the completion of T011, T016a, T024, T025, T026, T035, T017d_new, and T017e_new. Since T039 is an integration/orchestration task that consumes artifacts from all previous phases, it cannot run in parallel with any of its dependencies. The [P] tag is semantically incorrect for an end-to-end pipeline runner.

T021 is listed in Phase 2 (Foundational) but is tagged [US2] and described as a test for Benjamini-Hochberg correction. The description states 'Moved to Phase 4 to ensure it is completed after model schema definition,' yet it appears in Phase 2. This creates a contradiction in the ordering: it is placed before the implementation it tests (T017c) but labeled as a Phase 2 prerequisite. It should be moved to Phase 4 to align with the implementation it validates.
